```{r}
weather <- read.csv("seattle-weather.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

head(weather)
str(weather)

```
```{r}
cat("La dimension est :", dim(weather), "\n")



#donnes les nomes des variable were working with
cat("les colommes:",colnames(weather),"\n")

# Résumé statistique
summary(weather)

```
```{r}
#convertion des dates  et on appele une colonne par $
weather$date <- as.Date(weather$date)
#weather$date 
```
```{r}
#ici we checked les valeurs manquantes par variable
colSums(is.na(weather))

```
```{r}
mean(weather$temp_max)
mean(weather$temp_min)
sd(weather$temp_max)#écart-type
summary(weather$precipitation)


```
```{r}
weather_2016 <- subset(weather, format(as.Date(date), "%Y") == "2013")

plot(weather_2016$date, weather_2016$precipitation, type = "l",
     col = "red", xlab = "Date", ylab = "Température max",
     main = "Évolution de la température maximale à Seattle")

```
```{r}
plot(weather$date, weather$temp_min, type = "l",
     col = "blue", xlab = "Date", ylab = "Température min",
     main = "Évolution de la température minimale à Seattle")

```

```{r}
plot(weather$date, weather$temp_max, type = "l",
     col = "red", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Température (°C)",
     main = "Évolution des températures à Seattle")

lines(weather$date, weather$temp_min,
      col = "blue", lwd = 2)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Température max", "Température min"),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       lwd = 2)

```
```{r}
hist(weather$precipitation,
     main = "Distribution des précipitations",
     xlab = "Précipitations (mm)",
     col = "skyblue")
```
```{r}
table(weather$weather)

barplot(table(weather$weather),
        col = "orange",
        main = "Répartition des types de météo",
        ylab = "Nombre de jours")

```
```{r}
aggregate(temp_max ~ weather, data = weather, mean)
aggregate(precipitation ~ weather, data = weather, mean)

```
```{r}
weather_num <- weather[, c("precipitation", "temp_max", "temp_min", "wind")]
cor_matrix <- cor(weather_num, use = "complete.obs")
cor_matrix

```
```{r}
heatmap(cor_matrix, symm = TRUE)

```
```{r}
#on fait les 2 lignes suivantes pour istaller ;e package Corrplot
#install.packages("corrplot")  
#library(corrplot)

corrplot(cor_matrix,
         method = "color",
         type = "upper",
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black")

```
```{r}
weather$month <- format(weather$date, "%m")

boxplot(temp_max ~ month, data = weather,
        xlab = "Mois", ylab = "Température max",
        main = "Température maximale par mois")

```
```{r}
barplot(table(weather$weather),
        col = "steelblue",
        main = "Nombre de jours par type de météo")

```
```{r}
plot(weather$wind, weather$temp_min,
     col = "orange",
     xlab = "Température max",
     ylab = "Température min",
     main = "Relation temp_max / temp_min")

```
```{r}
plot(weather$precipitation, weather$temp_max,
     xlab = "Précipitations",
     ylab = "Température max",
     main = "Précipitations vs Température max")

```
```{r}
boxplot(temp_max ~ weather, data = weather,
        col = "lightblue",
        main = "Température max selon la météo")

```
```{r}
hist(weather$temp_max,
     col = "tomato",
     main = "Distribution de la température maximale",
     xlab = "Température max")
plot(density(weather$temp_max),
     main = "Densité de la température max")

```
```{r}
weather$delta_temp <- weather$temp_max - weather$temp_min

plot(weather$date, weather$delta_temp,
     type = "l",
     main = "Amplitude thermique journalière")


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(weather, aes(x = date, y = weather)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = weather)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "Weather type distribution over time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Weather type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plot(
  x = weather$temp_max,
  y = weather$temp_min,
  xlab = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
  ylab = "Minimum Temperature (°C)",
  main = "Temp_max vs Temp_min",
  col = rgb(1, 0.6, 0, alpha = 0.6),  # 半透明橙色
  pch = 1,                             # 空心圆
  cex = 0.8  
)

```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))  # 2×2 排版，一次画四张图

boxplot(temp_max ~ weather,
        data = weather,
        col = "orange",
        main = "Temp_max by Weather",
        xlab = "Weather type",
        ylab = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")

boxplot(temp_min ~ weather,
        data = weather,
        col = "skyblue",
        main = "Temp_min by Weather",
        xlab = "Weather type",
        ylab = "Minimum Temperature (°C)")

boxplot(wind ~ weather,
        data = weather,
        col = "lightgreen",
        main = "Wind speed by Weather",
        xlab = "Weather type",
        ylab = "Wind speed")

boxplot(precipitation ~ weather,
        data = weather,
        col = "plum",
        main = "Precipitation by Weather",
        xlab = "Weather type",
        ylab = "Precipitation (mm)")

par(mfrow=c(1,1))  # 画完恢复默认布局
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

features <- c("temp_max","temp_min","wind","precipitation")

for(f in features){
  p <- ggplot(weather, aes(x=weather, y=.data[[f]], fill=weather)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, outlier.alpha=0.3) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
    theme(legend.position="none",
          plot.title = element_text(face="bold")) +
    labs(title=paste(f,"by Weather"),
         x="Weather type",
         y=f)
  print(p)
}
```
